Vendored ONNX Runtime / onnxruntime-extensions dependency sources
==================================================================

These are the FetchContent dependencies that the ONNX Runtime build
(extern/onnxruntime, driven by rampart-build-cpu.sh) and the
onnxruntime-extensions build (rampart-build-ext.sh) would otherwise
download at build time.  They are vendored as UNPACKED, PRE-PATCHED
source trees and handed to CMake via FETCHCONTENT_SOURCE_DIR_<NAME>
(passed by the two rampart-build-*.sh wrappers), so the builds need no
network and are byte-reproducible.

IMPORTANT: with FETCHCONTENT_SOURCE_DIR overrides, CMake SKIPS both the
URL/hash verification and the PATCH_COMMAND steps — the patches listed
below are therefore ALREADY APPLIED to these trees.  When upgrading a
dep: fetch the new pinned archive (URL scheme below), re-apply the
corresponding patches from extern/onnxruntime/cmake/patches/<name>/ (or
extern/onnxruntime-extensions/cmake/externals/*.patch), and update this
file.

The cpuinfo tree carries ORT's Linux-only sysfs-fallback patch; it only
touches src/linux/processors.c, which non-Linux platforms never compile,
so the same tree is safe on every platform.  (ORT's Windows-ARM64
cpuinfo patches are NOT applied — we don't build there.)

Licenses: every tree retains its own LICENSE/LICENSE.txt/LICENSE.TXT
file.  All are permissive: Apache-2.0 (abseil, onnx, kleidiai,
sentencepiece), MIT (date, gsl, nlohmann_json, safeint), BSD-3-Clause
(protobuf, re2), BSD-2-Clause (cpuinfo), BSL-1.0 (mp11), MPL-2.0
(eigen — file-level weak copyleft, satisfied by shipping this unmodified
source).  Copies of licenses not already covered by
rampart/licenses/onnxruntime-third-party-notices.txt are in
rampart/licenses/ (date, mp11, GSL).
